At 632 meters tall, it is the third building in the world to exceed 600 meters and be designated “megatall.” [...] # China’s Newly Completed Shanghai Tower Is Now the 2nd Tallest Building in the World

Written by Eric Oh

Published on January 08, 2016

Gensler's recently completed Shanghai Tower is now the 2nd tallest building in the world, and the tallest building in China, according to The Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH). At 632 meters tall, it is the third building in the world to exceed 600 meters and be designated “megatall.” [...] "The tower’s program is unique for being organized into nine vertical zones. Each of these “vertical neighborhoods” rise from a sky lobby, a light-filled garden atrium that creates a sense of community and supports daily life with a varied program catering to tenants and visitors," writes the CTBUH.
